official_definition: (Once per Turn: Same Name) You can send the 20px from your Field/Reserve to your Life. When you've done so, you can put a core from the Void to your Trash.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Imaginate Seal] or [Imaginate Seal: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Imaginate Seal]", "give [Imaginate Seal]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
